title: Additional Measures to Encourage Prudent Bidding of Motorcycle COEs
what_it_is: Additional Measures to Encourage Prudent Bidding of Motorcycle COEs

sections.label: Motorcycle TCOE bidding measures
sections.summary: LTA raised the Cat D COE bid deposit to $800 and shortened Cat D TCOE validity to three months in March 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To help buyers obtain their motorcycles sooner, motorcycle dealers bid for and hold onto some Category D Temporary COEs or TCOEs, which can be used to first register a motorcycle before subsequent transfer to a buyer upon purchase.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: With rising Cat D COE quota premiums, there were some concerns that dealers were speculatively bidding and holding on to TCOEs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Thus, in March 2022, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) adjusted the Cat D COE bid deposit from $200 to $800, and shortened the Cat D TCOE validity period from six months to three months, to encourage prudent bidding behaviour.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor the situation closely and consider further actions, if necessary.

sections.label: COE quota computation change
sections.summary: The method of computing COE quota was changed to reduce quarter-to-quarter volatility in COE premiums, including motorcycle premiums.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To reduce the quarter-to-quarter volatility for the COE premiums, we have changed the method of computation for COE quota, which would also help in terms of the motorcycle COE premiums.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But some of these changes, the impact may take some time to flow through.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are monitoring the situation and we are prepared and will consider further actions if necessary.

sections.label: Cat D COEs and Cat E
sections.summary: LTA stopped the contribution of Cat D motorcycle COEs into Cat E, while other categories continued to contribute a percentage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can I ask has LTA ever transferred COEs from the open category to Cat D, for the motorcycles, to raise the number of COEs available for motorcycles?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I would say that, as the Member has pointed out, we have stopped the contribution of the number of the COEs from the motorcycle category, Cat D, into Cat E; whilst the others would have continued to contribute a certain percentage.
